summary: GPHC/East Street nurses action continued from Sep 25 (>100 reported for that September gathering) through Oct 5/7; October reports do not supply counts. Do not transfer September attendance to October or treat the continued series as a distinct October onset. Oct7 reports negotiations and suspension of strike action.
October 4 and October 24 West Berbice blockages are described as recurring since early September after Henry cousins were killed; onset precedes October and no series end is observed.
